signaling_summary: EtherCAT uses standard IEEE 802.3 100BASE-TX (3-level MLT-3, 4B5B-encoded, 25 Mbaud per pair, transformer-coupled to 100 Ω twisted pair) or 100BASE-FX (NRZI on multimode fiber) on the wire. EtherCAT G extends to 1 Gb/s using IEEE 802.3 1000BASE-T (PAM-5 on 4 pairs) or 1000BASE-X (8B/10B on fiber). The ESC-side MII / RMII / RGMII signaling is the conventional LVTTL/LVCMOS Ethernet PHY interface. EtherCAT P adds 24 V DC US (sensor/electronics) + 24 V DC UP (peripheral/actuator) power rails superimposed on the 100BASE-TX data pairs via ETG-specified coupling magnetics. The PDI signaling between ESC and the application µC is configurable across five families: 8/16-bit asynchronous parallel µC bus, 8/16-bit synchronous parallel µC bus, SPI slave, Digital I/O, and on-chip CPU bus.

100base_tx_signaling.encoding: 4B/5B then MLT-3 (3-level Manchester-suppressed) on one twisted pair per direction
100base_tx_signaling.cable: Cat 5 / 5e UTP, 100 Ω characteristic impedance, max segment 100 m
100base_tx_signaling.connector: 8P8C / RJ-45 (IEEE 802.3 standard), or M8 / M12 / M23 for industrial environments

100base_fx_signaling.encoding: 4B/5B then NRZI on one fiber strand per direction
100base_fx_signaling.cable: 62.5/125 µm or 50/125 µm multimode fiber; max segment 2 km

ethercat_g_signaling.1000BASE_T: PAM-5 across 4 pairs of Cat 5e UTP at 125 Mbaud per pair, 1 Gb/s aggregate
ethercat_g_signaling.1000BASE_X: 8B/10B on single fiber per direction at 1.25 Gbaud, 1 Gb/s aggregate

ethercat_p_signaling.coupling: ETG-specified magnetics combine the two 24 V rails with the differential 100BASE-TX signal on the same 4-conductor cable

esc_pdi_signaling.signals: CS_n, ADDR[15:0], DATA[7:0], WR_n, RD_n, READY, IRQ
CS_n, ADDR[15:0], DATA[15:0], WR_n, RD_n, BE0_n, BE1_n, READY, IRQ
CS_n, CLK, ADDR[15:0], DATA[7:0 or 15:0], WR_n, RD_n, IRQ

esc_pdi_signaling.modes_supported: Mode 3 (CPOL=1, CPHA=1) by default; Mode 0 selectable on most ESCs

esc_pdi_signaling.signals: Up to 32 output pins + up to 32 input pins + OUTVALID strobe + LATCH_IN strobe + IRQ
esc_pdi_signaling.note: Configured via SII; mapped to 0x0F00 region; provides direct register-level I/O without a µC

esc_pdi_signaling.signals: AMBA AHB / AXI / Avalon-MM (vendor-dependent) to embedded µC core
esc_pdi_signaling.note: Used in SoCs / FPGA-embedded ESC IP cores

esc_distributed_clock_io.description: First Distributed Clock interrupt / sync pulse output, period programmable in 0x0990.
Second DC pulse output, period programmable in 0x0994.
External event latch — captures System Time on rising/falling edge for event timestamping.

esc_phy_management_io.description: MII Management data (three-state, 1.5 kΩ pull-up at PHY).

esc_sii_eeprom_io.description: I²C-compatible 2-wire clock to SII EEPROM, typical 100/400 kHz.

esd_protection_class: Compliant with IEC 61000-4-2 ± 4 kV contact discharge on Ethernet ports (transformer-protected)
